claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Deracoxib is a selective COX-2 inhibitor with no known cytotoxic mechanism at 2.5 uM; any antiproliferative effect would be weak and non-selective, likely reflecting COX-2-independent off-target activity rather than a specific killing mechanism.
